title: 弥生賞の後に・次は……え？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru makes it through the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once again, our next goal race is left to fate! And the gods decree that our next race is… the formidable Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she has some gripes with the outcome, Matikanefukukitaru accepts her destiny. In order to claim victory in the Japanese Derby, she… runs off to improve her luck at a shrine.
